envelope.description: VS Code: add reloadWindow seam + reload-nudge on the update-success branch

body.title: VS Code: add reloadWindow seam + reload-nudge on the update-success branch
body.summary: In vscode-plugin/src/freshness/daemon-freshness.ts: add readonly reloadWindow?: () => Promise<void> to DaemonFreshnessDeps; change the confirmUpdate-success branch (currently notify('insrc daemon updated successfully.')) to notify the MCP-reload nudge with a 'Reload Window' action, and if the returned choice is 'Reload Window' and deps.reloadWindow is set, await it inside try/catch (swallow rejection). Fire-once/no-op/failed gating inherited (no new logic).
acceptanceChecks: DaemonFreshnessDeps has an optional reloadWindow?: () => Promise<void>
success branch calls notify(nudgeMsg, 'Reload Window'); choice 'Reload Window' + present seam -> await reloadWindow() once; rejection swallowed

tests.name: daemon-freshness: confirmed update -> notify called with reload-nudge message + 'Reload Window' action
daemon-freshness: notify resolves 'Reload Window' + seam present -> reloadWindow() invoked exactly once
daemon-freshness: notify dismissed (undefined) -> reloadWindow() NOT invoked
daemon-freshness: reloadWindow omitted -> notification-only, no crash
daemon-freshness: reloadWindow rejection swallowed -> runDaemonFreshnessCheck still resolves
daemon-freshness: no nudge on no-op update (commit unchanged) or failed update
